title: Up the Hill, Down the Hill: Average Speed | AMC 8-Style Level 5
description:
Jo bikes up a hill slowly and zooms back down. What's her average speed? Averaging the two speeds is a trap, and there's a second trap hiding in the units. Vantee shows two ways to get it right, then gives you a gentler hill to try.
